theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (T : Euclid n →L[ℝ] Euclid P) (j : ℝ) (f : Euclid P → ℝ), 0 ≤ j → (∀ S : Set (Euclid n), μHE[n] (T '' S) = ENNReal.ofReal j * volume S) → Continuous f → ∫ y in (LinearMap.range (T : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P) : Set (Euclid P)), f y ∂μHE[n] = j * ∫ c, f (T c) ∂volume
